beats.text: Sri Lanka spends 49.4% of total expenses on debt interest. In Iraq, it is 0.01%.
Sri Lanka has the world's highest burden. Interest alone consumes nearly half of its total expenses.
Iraq is the world's lowest. It pays almost nothing for its debt.
This counts interest on government debt paid to domestic and foreign residents.
Brazil at 24.1% and India at 23.2% both face heavy interest costs.
Sri Lanka has 3.8 times the interest burden of the USA.
How much does your government spend on debt interest?
